messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int count;
    std::cin >> count;
    if (count == 1) {
        int value;
        std::cin >> value;
        std::cout << value;
        return 0;
    }
    std::vector<int> numbers;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        int num;
        std::cin >> num;
        numbers.push_back(num);
    }
    std::sort(numbers.begin(), numbers.end());
    std::cout << numbers[(count - 1) / 2];
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
